title: Products that use AI to generate stories in one way or another
author: Tiendil

comments.author: Puzzleheaded_Act5292
comments.body:
this is a solid list, appreciate you grouping by category and adding funding/team size where you could ! One gap I keep noticing in these roundups is tools that care more about *long-session continuity* than one-shot prose quality. a lot of AI story products still fall apart once you have recurring NPCs, secrets, and a world state that has to stay consistent past the honeymoon chapter.  
  
I’ve been poking at Neta Studio lately for that reason (more interactive/story-world side than pure game engine). not saying it belongs in every bucket on your list, but if you’re collecting narrative-generation products it might be worth a look under the “playable story / persistent world” type tools rather than straight writers. either way, thanks for publishing the list!
